title: Register vector representation
statement: For a machine configuration, its register vector is the function from the $15$ register indices to the natural numbers whose entries, in order, are the query-length/decode pointer, pair-scan pointer, input length, scratch register, loop counter, radius, vertex exponent, $2n$, $2n^2$, width cap, width-check pointer, index/remaining offset, decoding/comparison scratch, source vertex, and shift scratch.
